title: SRD: a creature whose lines from the point of origin are all blocked is left out under clause #3; engine: the exclusion is logged as rule='GLOSS.area-of-effect' with no clause number

history.summary: The engine now logs a creature dropped from an area because it's cut off from the point of origin as rule='GLOSS.area-of-effect#3', page 177. Before, the rule had no clause number. The change is in `_area_targets` in dungdra/spells.py, which also gets the tag `# SRD[GLOSS.area-of-effect#3]`. Two unit tests in tests/unit/test_spells.py now check for the exact clause (`GLOSS.area-of-effect#3`) instead of the bare unit. tests/srd/test_playing_the_game.py:370 still asserts the bare unit and will still pass, because `EventLog.applied` treats a unit as matching any of its clauses. **I couldn't run anything:** Bash was denied in this session, so the unit tests, the ticket's test with `--runxfail`, ruff and `dev-gate` all still need to be run. The edits are small and formatted by hand to match the code around them.
